h01.

**Component — schedule — wiring site:**
`s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16-45`) — refreshes presigned S3 URLs for attachments whose `LastPresignedTime` is more than 4 days old (5-day expiry, checked/renewed every 12 hours via `time.NewTicker(runnerInterval)` where `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40,85-91`) — wired into server startup at `server/server.go:162-169` inside `startBackgroundRunners`, which is itself invoked from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

Details:
- It runs `RunOnce` immediately at startup (`server/server.go:163`) and then launches `Run` in a goroutine (`server/server.go:167-169`) which ticks every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-40`).
- `CheckAndPresign` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:47-132`) lists all S3-backed attachments and, for any whose presigned URL was last generated more than 4 days ago, calls `s3Client.PresignGetObject` to mint a fresh URL and persists it via `Store.UpdateAttachment`, keeping the externally-stored (S3) attachment links from expiring/going stale.

h02.

**Delivery function — path:**
`Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180` (invoked synchronously, and asynchronously via a bounded worker pool through `PostAsync` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-196`, which enqueues onto `asyncPostQueue` consumed by the goroutines started in `init()` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`). The actual outbound HTTP request is executed by `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`.

**Protection mechanism — path:**
The shared `safeClient` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`) uses a custom `http.Transport` whose `DialContext` is set to `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`). At dial time, `safeDialContext` resolves the target hostname and rejects the connection if any resolved IP falls in a reserved/private range, using `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44-54`) against the CIDR list `reservedCIDRs`/`reservedNetworks` (loopback, RFC‑1918 private ranges, link-local/cloud IMDS `169.254.0.0/16`, and IPv6 equivalents — `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-36`). This dial-time check defeats DNS-rebinding attacks, since it validates the IP actually being connected to rather than the hostname checked earlier. A separate, earlier check, `ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83`), performs the same reserved-IP validation at webhook-URL-registration time (scheme + hostname resolution check) so that invalid/internal URLs are rejected before ever being saved. (Both checks can be disabled for self-hosted use via the `AllowPrivateIPs` flag, `internal/webhook/validate.go:41`.)
